name: tandem
description: A balanced identity for a shared-mobility platform. Two linked loops, a clean teal, and functional typography express connection through the simplest possible geometry.
heading: urbanist
rules: Both loops use equal dimensions and a shared baseline.
Keep interface spacing on a four-unit rhythm.
Use petrol text on porcelain for route and journey information.

system.concept: Braided loops, wheel-like negative spaces, clean route diagrams, and friendly functional typography. Connection is expressed through continuous geometry and shared direction.
headline: A better way
to move together.
features: A useful way to connect people going somewhere similar.
Thoughtful route information and simple journey planning.
A cooperative approach to moving through the everyday.
system.layoutNote: Porcelain split hero with oversized mint loop artwork. Petrol route text, rounded itinerary cards, and consistent 4px spacing increments.
